title: Slum Rehabilitation (SRA)
description: UI schema for Stage 3 of the Area Analysis v2 wizard — DCPR 33(10) pilot. Field keys map 1:1 to AreaCalcEngine input keys (see lib/AreaCalcEngine.php::mapInputs) so no translation layer is needed on save.

sections.title: Plot & deductions
sections.blurb: Enter the gross plot and every deduction. Net plot updates as you type.

fields.label: Gross plot area
fields.tip: Total plot area before any deductions. Taken from the property card / survey record.

fields.label: Primary road width
fields.tip: Width of the main road adjoining the plot. Determines some FSI eligibilities.

fields.label: Road setbacks
fields.help: One row per road frontage. Each row = road width + the deduction area it takes off the plot.

fields.label: Named deductions (nalla, CRZ, etc.)
fields.help: Any other named deduction such as nalla setback or CRZ. Un-check 'include' if the deduction is informational only.

fields.label: Reservation area
fields.help: Green Belt / ROS / public amenity reservation. Usually retains FSI (leave the checkbox off).

sections.title: Amenity handover (Reg 14(A))
sections.blurb: Area handed over as an amenity plot per Reg 14(A). Reduces net plot but may not reduce FSI.

fields.label: Amenity handover area
fields.help: Blank = no amenity handover. Leave 0 if not applicable.

sections.title: Rehab drivers
sections.blurb: Eligible-tenement count + carpet area + loading factor drive the Rehab BUA for 33(10).

fields.label: Eligible tenements
fields.help: Count of slum tenements eligible for rehab (post-eligibility cut-off list).

fields.label: Carpet · residential
fields.tip: Minimum SRA residential carpet floor is 27.88 sqm. Edit only if the sanction allows a different carpet.

fields.label: Loading factor
fields.tip: Ratio to convert tenement carpet area → BUA. Typically 1.15 for SRA.

fields.label: Amenity built BUA
fields.help: Common amenity area built as part of the scheme (society office / welfare / community hall).

sections.title: In-situ sale (optional)
sections.blurb: Row 15 of the Feasibility Statement. Leave blank to use the auto-computed maximum = min(Sale Component, Gross × in-situ FSI cap − Rehab).

fields.label: Proposed Sale BUA In-Situ
fields.help: How much of the Sale Component you actually plan to build on-site. If left blank, the Feasibility view shows the maximum allowable value flagged as auto-max · unconfirmed.
fields.tip: The engine clips this to the in-situ FSI cap. The remainder of the Sale Component becomes Balance Sale BUA / TDR (Row 18).
